scripts.build:full: pnpm prepare:ort && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b && cross-env VITE_BUILD_PROFILE=full node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build
scripts.build:core:firefox: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config vite.config.firefox.ts
scripts.build:full:firefox: pnpm prepare:ort && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -b && cross-env VITE_BUILD_PROFILE=full node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config vite.config.firefox.ts
scripts.test:ci: pnpm test:scanner && pnpm test:filter-audit && pnpm build:core && pnpm exec playwright install chromium && pnpm exec playwright test tests/core-filtering.spec.ts tests/onboarding/wizard-install-e2e.spec.ts tests/scanner-acceptance-e2e.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:core: pnpm build && node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js install chromium && node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test tests/core-filtering.spec.ts tests/onboarding/wizard-install-e2e.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:acceptance: pnpm build && node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js install chromium && node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test tests/scanner-acceptance-e2e.spec.ts
scripts.release:chrome: pnpm build:core && node scripts/verify-store-build.mjs dist && node scripts/package-release.mjs --dir dist --label signallens-chrome-core
scripts.release:firefox: pnpm build:core:firefox && node scripts/verify-store-build.mjs dist-firefox && node scripts/package-release.mjs --dir dist-firefox --label signallens-firefox-core
scripts.test:firefox: pnpm build:core:firefox && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts tests/firefox
